scope: Read-only follow-up of three previously reported coordinator/workflow defects and navigation timeout handling. Source and authored tests reviewed; existing validation logs read.

findings.original_problem: A valid grading configuration could differ from the one frozen for a sealed session.
findings.resolution: grade now compares language, arm, application derived from task block, and required session trial_configuration_sha256 against supplied configuration before publishing a plan. Existing full configuration verification remains.
findings.test_observation: Regression explicitly rejects a changed configuration hash. Missing hash and app/arm mismatch rejection are clear in source but not separately exercised in this test.

findings.original_problem: Exceptions before run returned skipped creation of the requested attempt report.
findings.resolution: Manifest/execution errors are represented in the partial report; startup errors become infrastructure-failure reports in main. Both use exclusive report creation. Post-run identity read errors produce stale reports. Existing-report refusal is retained; write errors expose the attempted report on stdout.
findings.test_observation: New malformed-manifest test requires a persisted infrastructure-failure file retaining successful compilation and unchanged identity.

findings.original_problem: Only .my source, compiler and manifest identities were compared, so changes to Python tests or JSON fixtures could retain acceptance.
findings.resolution: identity now captures the complete bounded regular-file project tree in addition to compiler, .my and manifest hashes. The existing before/after comparison marks altered tests/fixtures stale for v1 as well as v2.
findings.test_observation: New regression covers both test_cli.py and fixture.json mutations; earlier .my mutation and cached v2 invalidation tests remain.

findings.original_problem: subprocess.TimeoutExpired escaped the workflow exception handlers and could lose attempt evidence.
findings.resolution: Navigation, verification and main startup exception handlers now include subprocess.SubprocessError, the superclass of TimeoutExpired. Navigation failure cannot run tests or produce successful acceptance.
findings.test_observation: Verified from exception types/control flow; the supplied seven workflow tests do not include an explicit timeout-injection regression.

limits: Reviewer did not execute tests, applications, grading or Guardian gates. Recorded test outcomes are observations of existing logs, not independent reruns.
This follow-up verifies the reported fixes; it is not an exhaustive audit of every scheduler, parser or storage dependency.
Full-tree before/after comparison detects persistent changes, not transient modifications restored before final capture. V2 complete input declarations remain an explicit trust contract.
No report can be persisted if its destination cannot be written; that path now returns the attempted report in stdout.
The report pins reviewed source bytes because root working-tree changes may not yet be committed.
No timing or productivity conclusions are drawn.
